report:
Reviewed the full fresh crates.sage_ir.types.body.indexing claim and its entire associated implementation/test set. It requires index syntax to become a resolved Index or IndexMut call with typed operands. The trait-call selection, both immutable and mutable indexing cases as appropriate, resolved call representation and operand typing must all be established; a typed source-shaped Index node alone does not satisfy the claim.

The sole implementation association is the explicit sage_meta::todo marker in crates/sage-meta/tests/representation_spec.rs, stating that Index trait-call elaboration remains pending. The sole test is sage_meta::todo::types_body_indexing, containing only that explanatory TODO and no assertions. There are no ordinary or N/A entries. A passing placeholder would not establish either Index or IndexMut behavior.

Captured the current indexing checker branch as additional context. It checks the object and index expressions, explicitly comments that Index/IndexMut must be selected and materialized before successful elaboration, emits an indexing-elaboration-not-supported diagnostic, allocates Ty::Error with the reported witness, and returns the transitional TyExprData::Index node. This is explicit unsupported handling, not a resolved trait call. The existing TODO therefore has a concrete implementation prerequisite. Operand checking and diagnosed rejection are not promoted here to evidence that indexing elaboration is complete, nor does this report assert more about recovery behavior than this captured branch shows.

Captured the typed-IR destination table and accepted architectural-foundations completed-body rationale. They require resolved semantic operations in the typed tree while remaining above lower-level control-flow machinery. They provide context, not test execution. Replacing the deferral requires Index and IndexMut selection/materialization and annotated fixtures directly inspecting the resolved method identity, the appropriate indexing family, and typed object/index operands in completed output. Representative immutable-read and mutable-place cases must distinguish the two; syntax retention or absence of diagnostics alone would be inadequate.

All claim aspects remain explicitly deferred. No specification weakening or N/A exemption is used. Performed source inspection through review start/read only, with no source edits or behavioral tests. Coordinator-run suites remain separate execution evidence. No requested edits: the existing implementation and test TODO honestly retain the unsupported indexing elaboration.
